construction_details.gear_material: Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear

official_feature_text: Elevating precision and unleashing limitless potential, Lew’s® Custom Pro Baitcast Reel features an ultra-compact design with 30mm spool, it boldly redefines expectations of quality and performance. Within the sleek, one-piece aluminum frame lies ParaMag® ITB (Inertia Transfer Braking) – the highest-quality cast control on the market, enabling maximum cast control and efficiency without sacrificing casting distance. After dialing in settings to meet your preferences, ITB takes the reins. Its highly responsive magnetic system seamlessly adjusts, providing precisely the right amount of force in proportion to your casting speed, virtually eliminating the need to thumb the spool with every cast. Feel the surge of power coursing throughout every mechanism of this reel, from the hard aluminum Speed Gears® with P2 Super Pinion® bearing supported pinion gear and premium 11-bearing system with double shielded stainless steel ball bearings to the carbon fiber drag system with 20 lbs. of drag power. The aircraft-grade double anodized Duralumin drilled spool with Speed Knot® line attachment feature is lightweight and durable, while the bowed 95mm carbon fiber handle with Lew’s Pro Power knobs provide increased leverage and comfort. Finer details like the Lew’s exclusive patented titanium-coated zirconia two-stage line guide for extended casting distance, Speed Dial® line indicator, and Speed Keeper® hook keeper will easily propel the Custom Pro to the top spot in your line up.
Patented Speed Dial® line indicator allows for easy identification of line type and pound test
Patented retractable Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows you to secure lures and Texas rigged baits without scratching your reel
Speed Knot™ quick line attachment spool
ParaMag® ITB braking system
One-piece aluminum frame and sideplates
Premium 11 bearing system
30mm aluminum spool with Speed Knot®
95mm aluminum handle with Pro Power Knobs
Carbon fiber drag system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle
Titanium-coated zirconia line guide
Aluminum sideplates
Anodized Aluminum 30mm
PARAMAG® ITB’s highly responsive magnetic system seamlessly adjusts, providing precisely the right amount of force in proportion to your casting speed
ONE-PIECE ALUMINUM SUPER LOW-PROFILE FRAME features C45 carbon sideplates and a recessed brake dial for streamlined look and comfort
DURALUMIN DRILLED 30mm SPOOL is aircraft-grade and double anodized with Speed Knot® quick line attachment feature
11-BEARING SYSTEM with double-shielded stainless steel ball bearings for smooth performance
SPEED GEARS® with P2 bearing supported pinion gear for smoothness and durability
CARBON FIBER DRAG SYSTEM delivering 20 lbs. of max drag power
DURALUMIN DRILLED U-SHAPE 30mm SPOOL is aircraft-grade and double anodized with Speed Knot® quick line attachment feature

official_feature_text: From the mind of professional angler Andy Montgomery and the engineering team at Lew’s® comes the new Team Lew’s Pro SP Skipping and Pitching reel. The super shallow spool holds 40 yards of 20-pound-test fluorocarbon for faster spool start up and reduced deep spool backlashes. The innovative Knot Slot recesses the spool knot so you have smooth, even line lay. The externally adjustable QuietCast® ACB system includes a special “Skipping Zone” to maximize distance and reduce backlash when skipping a bait under a dock. The result is a reel that has all the performance of a Lew’s reel, finely tuned for skipping and pitching. According to Montgomery, “This reel let’s me skip a bait further and with less backlash than ever before.”
Patented retractable Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows you to secure lures and Texas rigged baits without scratching your reel

official_feature_text: Doubling down on power and efficiency, Lew’s® Custom Baitcast Reel is a force to be reckoned with. Experience top performance with the new ParaMag™ RX Braking System, providing maximum cast control without sacrificing casting distance. The one-piece aluminum frame with recessed brake dial design allows for all-day palming comfort while the 10-bearing system with stainless steel double shielded ball bearings deliver effortlessly smooth operation. The hard, anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears® are precisely cut on Hamai CNC machines and feature a P2 Super Pinion™ bearing supporting pinion gear to maintain faultless alignment and increase crank power and durability. The 20 lb. carbon fiber max drag system produces the force needed to overpower massive bass and the 95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle with Lew’s new paddle knobs afford the leverage needed to do so. The patented Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows for easy lure storage and the patented Speed Dial® line indicator helps with easy identification of line type and pound test.

official_feature_text: High-speed performance facilitated by high-quality components – Lew’s Speed Spool Baitcast Reel easily surpasses the competition and looks good doing it. Expertly delivering both power and speed, the reel is equipped with a 10-bearing system with stainless steel double shielded ball bearings, high strength solid brass Speed Gears®, a P2 Super Pinion® bearing supported pinion gear, and a Rulon drag system with 15 lbs. max drag to ensure you’re always prepared for any battle on the water. The one-piece aluminum frame and graphite sideplates are lightweight and durable, and feature a recessed, externally adjustable Magnetic Control System (MCS) for easy fine tuning to meet your preferences. The reel also features an anodized aluminum, U-shaped 34mm spool, a 95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle with paddle knobs, and an external lube port. Elevate your game with the Lew’s Speed Spool Baitcast Reel – where precision meets passion.

official_feature_text:
The Accel™ RX Baitcast Reel is built with the innovative ParaMag® RX™ braking system, a friction-free, radial paramagnetic design that ensures exceptional castability while providing maximum control and minimizing backlashes for smoother, more precise performance every time. This hassle-free system applies even force across the brake surface without requiring electronics or batteries, offering reliable, noise-free operation with no need for maintenance.
Built with a 6 bearing system, it ensures smooth and reliable operation. Its lightweight graphite frame and side covers provide a perfect balance of strength and durability without weighing you down. Brass gears, meticulously cut on advanced Hamai CNC machines, deliver unparalleled cranking power with less wear, ensuring a smooth, consistent retrieve. The 32mm spool, equipped with a Knot Slot, offers superior strength under pressure and makes line connection easy and seamless.

official_feature_text: Okuma X-Series Low Profile Baitcast Reel Crafted with a diecast aluminum frame, the all-new X-Series Baitcast Reel ensures maximum rigidity and performance on the water. Its C-40X carbon injected side plates not only reduce weight but also enhance the reel's overall strength, resulting in a lightweight 5.6-ounce reel design that doesn't compromise on durability. Equipped with an aluminum main and brass pinion gear, the X-Series delivers tournament-grade performance, and a tournament feel, providing anglers with the confidence to tackle any fishing challenge with ease. The Carbonite drag system boasts an impressive 24-lbs maximum drag output and features a micro-click drag star and spool tension knob for precise stopping power. Featuring a machined aluminum, ported spool for reduced weight and enhanced casting performance, the X-Series baitcast reel offers precision and control like never before. The Quick-Set anti-reverse roller bearing provides instant hooksets and eliminates back play, giving anglers the edge in landing their next personal best. Designed with versatility in mind, the X-Series baitcast reel is equipped with a Velocity Control System with 18 adjustable positions and allows anglers to fine-tune their casting for optimal performance. The hinged palm side plate provides easy access to Velocity Cast control, while the adjustable line management system ensures precise line control in any fishing scenario. Available in a 100 size in both left- and right-hand retrieve, the X-Series Baitcast Reel features 7.3:1 and high-speed 8.1:1 gear ratios, offering versatility and performance for anglers.

official_feature_text: Built specifically for those who fish with nothing less than the best, Lew’s® is pleased to unveil the ALL NEW design of the Pro-Ti baitcast reel.  With the Pro-Ti, Lew’s is launching much more than a reel with robust features; we are launching a full experience from cast to catch - unprecedented palming comfort and control, the perfect cast and remarkable retrieval smoothness. Lew’s hardened aluminum Speed Gears® has awakened a new level of operational smoothness to the modern baitcast reel, resulting in an exceptionally quiet and effortless retrieval. The premium P2 Super Pinion® is built for a robust gear stability to extend gear life and offer the angler competition-level durability. With the innovative recessed brake dial, the Pro-Ti yields a level of fishing comfort and control that is simply without peer among low profile reels
Patented Speed Dial® line indicator allows for easy identification of line type and pound test
Carbon fiber drag system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed carbon fiber handle
Titanium-coated zirconia line guide
Aluminum sideplates
Double Anodized Duralumin 32mm Speed Knot
PREMIUM one-piece aluminum frame with titanium deposition finish for tournament-ready, lightweight performance on the water.
EXCEPTIONAL CRANKING and fish-handling performance with Lew’s hardened alloy Speed Gears® and top-quality P2 super Pinion® gear system
REMARKABLE CASTING with the easy-to-adjust ACB QuietCast® System and recessed external control dial
SUPERIOR DESIGN for high-level gear performance, all-day comfort and years of fishing
RELIABILITY with a rock-solid warranty for peace of mind on the water
Speed Knot® quick line attachment spool
95mm bowed carbon handle with new JDM style Winn® Dri-Tac handle grips
SLP Super Low-Profile design with superior control ergonomics
Speed Keeper® hook keeper
Speed Dial® line indicator
External lube port

PREMIUM one-piece aluminum frame with a titanium deposition finish for tournament-ready lightweight performance on the water. Competitive anglers demand a reel that is perfectly balanced, ideally weighted and can be fished all day

EXCEPTIONAL CRANKING and fish-handling performance with Lew’s hardened alloy Speed Gears® and top-quality P2 super Pinion® gear system. High stakes competition calls for precise gear alignment and solid cranking stability. There is simply no gear system that operates with the smoothness of the P2 Super Pinion. This translates to extended gear life and effortless operation on the water. Take your mind off the reel and put it back on the fishing with the Pro-Ti P2 Super Pinion

REMARKABLE CASTING with the easy-to-adjust ACB QuietCast® system. Lew’s puts the angler back in control of long, consistent, and effortless casts by perfectly aligning braking power to changing conditions. The ACB braking system is adjusted on an external palming dial, perfectly recessed for palming comfort and effortless control

SUPERIOR DESIGN for high-level performance, all-day comfort and years of fishing. The Pro-Ti’s 11 bearing system, crafted with premium double-shielded stainless-steel bearings, is built to stand the test of time. The 95mm bowed carbon handle and Winn® Dri-Tac grips pair perfectly with the carbon fiber drag system for fish-fighting control. The team at Lew’s fishes in the same harsh conditions you do, with fierce competition and with pride and a paycheck on the line

official_feature_text: Continuing to push the limits of innovation and performance, Team Lew’s® has redesigned the HyperMag® baitcast reel to enhance not only function, but experience. The HyperMag baitcast reel includes the P2 Super Pinion® double bearing supported pinion gear, offering a better gear mesh for smoothness and extended gear life. The ergonomic one-piece magnesium frame and C40 carbon sideplates are strong and extremely lightweight, with the reel weighing in at only 5.2 oz. The “barely-there” feel of this reel is ever-present, giving anglers the comfort and control they desire. The features don’t stop there – the recessed brake adjustment dial contributes to the low-profile design, the Speed Knot™ quick line attachment spool enables easy and quick line attachment, and the JDM-style Winn® handle knobs provide outstanding grip and comfort. In line with the original, the new HyperMag has a 4-pin SpeedCast® externally Adjustable Centrifugal Brake (ACB) system, 11 bearing system, Speed Keeper® hook keeper, and Speed Dial® line indicator, bringing all of the best features together in one of Lew’s lightest, most efficient baitcast reel to date.
Speed Knot™ quick line attachment spool
Carbon fiber drag system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed carbon fiber handle
Titanium-coated zirconia line guide
C45 Carbon sideplates
Aircraft-grade double anodized Duralumin drilled and chamfered U-shape 32mm spool
MAGNESIUM FRAME DESIGN is one-piece and extremely lightweight, providing an ergonomic, "barely-there" feel while also affording anglers comfort and control

ADJUSTABLE CENTRIFUGAL BRAKE (ACB) system with 6-pin QuietCast® puts anglers in control of their casts by allowing precise brake modification to match fishing conditions, and has a recessed adjustment dial for ease of access
SPEED KNOT® quick line attachment spool requires half the effort of regular spools to tie on line and hides the knot at the base of the spool
P2 SUPER PINION® double bearing supported pinion gear delivers smooth, high-powered cranking and longer gear life to withstand the strain of pulling in large fish repeatedly
JDM STYLE WINN® handle knobs are comfortable with enhanced grip for increased traction for all-day usage without fatigue

official_feature_text: Okuma Hakai Low Profile Baitcast Reels Discover the upgraded Okuma Hakai Baitcast Reel—stronger, more durable, and engineered with cutting-edge technology for peak performance. Developed with insights from top anglers worldwide, its ultra-light 5.9 oz LITECAST™ magnesium alloy frame ensures superior strength while maintaining an extra-compact, ergonomic design that fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. Featuring FLITE SPOOL and FLITE SHAFT technology for effortless precision casting, the Hakai now boasts a reinforced stainless steel handle arm and drive shaft for enhanced durability, making it the ultimate choice for serious anglers. Okuma has developed FLITE-SPOOL and FLITE-SHAFT technology into the Hakai. This allows for a super-tuned spool with unrivaled performance. The 33mm O/D all-purpose spool weighs only 9.5g (0.33oz) total with the bearing. The Hakai also features a patented hollow stainless-steel SUS FLITE SHAFT with precision SUS balls and provides a perfect balance between weight, strength, and smoothness. Hakai low-profile reels allow anglers of any skill level to confidently cast even the lightest of lures up to 3g (0.10 oz). Hakai can definitely bring you an unprecedented casting experience, allowing you to go fishing without any disadvantages.

official_feature_text:
The KVD Elite Casting Reel is built for anglers who demand precision and reliability in every cast. Equipped with the advanced PARAMAG® RX Braking System, it ensures total control during long casts while minimizing backlashes for seamless performance. Its Premium 7 Bearing System, featuring stainless steel double-shielded ball bearings, delivers smooth, consistent operation that lasts. Designed for unmatched retrieval, the reel features anodized aluminum Speed Gears® with P2 Super Pinion® technology for perfect gear alignment and long-term smoothness.
To enhance functionality, the Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing provides instant hook-setting power without backplay, while the carbon fiber drag system delivers max drag power to handle tough catches with confidence. The patented retractable Speed Keeper® bait keeper adds convenience, keeping your bait secure when not in use. The 2-stage titanium-coated zirconia line guide promotes longer casts and ensures smooth, precise line placement, reducing wear and enhancing casting performance. Maintenance is simple with the external lube port, and the level-wind system ensures even line distribution across the spool for tangle-free operation.
With its extremely strong aluminum frame and lightweight graphite sideplates, the KVD Elite Casting Reel combines strength and durability without adding unnecessary weight. Balancing power, precision, and durability, this reel delivers a dependable fishing experience every time.
External lube port
Level-wind system
Patented retractable Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows you to secure lures and Texas rigged baits without scratching your reel
Paramag RX magnetic cast control system
Hard anodized aluminum Speed Gears®

official_feature_text:
At the heart of the reel lies the PARAMAG® ITB braking system, a highly responsive technology that adapts seamlessly to your casting speed. With perfect balance, friction-free operation, and noise-free performance, it ensures effortless, accurate casts every time by applying just the right amount of force.

Paired with a 10-bearing system featuring double-shielded stainless steel ball bearings, the reel operates with an incredibly smooth, fluid feel. Power and performance are guaranteed with an impressive 20 lbs of max drag, giving you the confidence to tame even the strongest bass. The Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing offers instant hook-setting power with no backplay.

When it comes to convenience, the reel boasts innovative features like the patented Speed Keeper® hook keeper, offering secure storage for hooks of all sizes, and the Speed Dial® line indicator, which simplifies line type and weight identification. Plus, the Speed Lube® treatment ensures exceptional performance in all weather conditions, while the external lube port makes maintenance quick and easy. Crafted for precision, the hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, machined on Hamai CNC machines, work in tandem with the P2 SuperPinion® bearing-supported pinion gear for unmatched reliability. Built around a strong aluminum frame with lightweight C45 carbon side plates, the design ensures durability without compromising on weight. The 200-size double anodized aluminum spool, made from aircraft-grade material, features the Speed Knot® quick line attachment system, further enhancing its usability.

The Lew's Speed Spool® ITB 200 baitcast reel delivers expert-level engineering designed to tackle any challenge on the water. Built for precision and packed with advanced features, this reel offers the perfect balance of power, smoothness, and convenience.

official_feature_text:
At the heart of the reel lies the PARAMAG® ITB braking system, a highly responsive technology that adapts seamlessly to your casting speed. With perfect balance, friction-free operation, and noise-free performance, it ensures effortless, accurate casts every time by applying just the right amount of force.

Paired with a 10-bearing system featuring double-shielded stainless steel ball bearings, the reel operates with an incredibly smooth, fluid feel. Power and performance are guaranteed with an impressive 20 lbs of max drag, giving you the confidence to tame even the strongest bass. The Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing offers instant hook-setting power with no backplay.

When it comes to convenience, the reel boasts innovative features like the patented Speed Keeper® hook keeper, offering secure storage for hooks of all sizes, and the Speed Dial® line indicator, which simplifies line type and weight identification. Plus, the Speed Lube® treatment ensures exceptional performance in all weather conditions, while the external lube port makes maintenance quick and easy. Crafted for precision, the hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, machined on Hamai CNC machines, work in tandem with the P2 SuperPinion® bearing-supported pinion gear for unmatched reliability. Built around a strong aluminum frame with lightweight C45 carbon side plates, the design ensures durability without compromising on weight. The 200-size double anodized aluminum spool, made from aircraft-grade material, features the Speed Knot® quick line attachment system, further enhancing its usability.

The Lew's Speed Spool® ITB 200 baitcast reel delivers expert-level engineering designed to tackle any challenge on the water. Built for precision and packed with advanced features, this reel offers the perfect balance of power, smoothness, and convenience.

official_feature_text: Okuma Eminent Low Profile Baitcast Reel Lightweight Design. Precision Performance. Built to Fish. The Okuma Eminent Low Profile Baitcast Reel is engineered for anglers who demand lightweight strength, smooth performance, and total control on the water. Built around a rigid yet lightweight C-40X carbon frame, gear sideplate, and palm sideplate , the Eminent delivers long-lasting durability without added weight—perfect for all-day casting. At its core, the Eminent features a CNC-cut aluminum drive gear with anodizing paired with a machine-cut brass pinion gear , creating a strong, efficient drivetrain designed for smooth power transfer and long-term reliability. The 5BB + 1RB bearing system ensures fluid operation on every cast and retrieve. Available in 6.6:1, 7.3:1, and 8.1:1 gear ratios (with a 7.3:1 left-hand retrieve option ), the Eminent gives anglers the flexibility to match their reel to their preferred techniques—from slower presentations to high-speed applications. Designed for control and casting precision, the Eminent is equipped with an external adjustable magnetic cast control system , allowing you to fine-tune performance for different baits and conditions. A 2-tone anodized machined aluminum spool enhances durability while maintaining smooth line flow. When it’s time to put pressure on a fish, the carbon fiber drag system delivers up to 20 lbs of max drag , providing consistent stopping power when it counts. The 95mm carbon fiber swept handle arm adds leverage and comfort, giving you better control during long retrieves and tough fights. For added feedback, the Eminent features a JDM-style audible spool click , delivering an audible cue during drag engagement—perfect for anglers who appreciate that extra level of connection. Backed by a 1-year limited warranty , the Okuma Eminent Low Profile Baitcast Reel is built to perform, cast after cast.

official_feature_text:
With the ability to excel under any condition, Lew’s® American Hero Baitcast Reel is a force to be reckoned with. With a lighter weight and lower profile than its predecessor, the American Hero® Baitcast Reel features a one-piece graphite frame with lightweight graphite sideplates that house a 5-bearing system with stainless steel double shielded ball bearings, high strength solid brass Speed Gears® that are precision cut on Hamai CNC machines, and a Rulon max drag system with 15 lbs. of drag power. The externally adjustable Magnetic Control System (MCS) is precise and easy to fine tune to your preferences, while the anodized 32mm aluminum spool is strong and lightweight to withstand pressure from any type of line. Precision-engineered to dominate, the Lew’s American Hero Baitcast is meticulously crafted for enthusiasts who demand nothing short of optimal performance.

Lew’s pledges a portion of profits from the sale of every American Hero reel, rod, and combo for the purpose of supporting and helping organized programs that benefit the mind, spirit, soul, and body of our veterans in their return to enjoying recreational opportunities outdoors, such as fishing

Externally adjustable Magnetic Control System (MCS)
Speed Lube® for exceptional smoothness
Rulon drag system

95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle
Graphite sideplates
Anodized aluminum U-shape 32mm spool

32mm ANODIZED ALUMINUM SPOOL for lightweight strength under pressure
RULON DRAG SYSTEM with 15 lbs. of max drag power
SPEED GEARS® are precision cut on Hamai CNC machines and made of solid brass

official_feature_text: Equipping finesse anglers with ultimate baitcasting distance and control, Lew's® is pleased to introduce the Custom Lite Shallow Spool Baitcast Reel. Built for baitcast enthusiasts who rely on finesse crankbaits, small topwaters, and lightweight soft plastics to get the job done, the Custom Lite is built with a premium QuietCast® Adjustable Centrifugal Braking system and Lew's innovative free spool rotation design to deliver an exceptionally long and accurate cast with finesse-sized baits.
Ultra Shallow Ported Spool with Speed Knot™
Carbon fiber drag system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed carbon fiber handle
Titanium-coated zirconia line guide
C45 Carbon sideplates
Anodized Duralumin 30mm Shallow Spool Speed Knot

ULTIMATE CASTING DISTANCE: Cast the lightest baits farther with accuracy and ease. Effortlessly adjust Lew's QuietCast® Adjustable Centrifugal Braking system with an external dial for ultimate cast control. The ultra shallow 30mm spool design requires less inertia to spin when casting light weights, helping you put finesse baits exactly where you want them in any condition

LIGHTWEIGHT FRAME: Feel the slightest vibration of micro crankbaits and detect the softest bites from finicky fish with Lew's super light Tanso Tech™ one-piece frame and duralumin spool. A featherweight frame that is an absolute must for finesse performance

PREMIUM CRAFTSMANSHIP: Experience unmatched quality with aluminum alloy Speed Gears® with the P2 Super Pinion®, C45 Carbon Side Plates and 11 Stainless Steel Double Shielded ball bearings. Lew's legendary performance at the lightest weight. The innovative Speed Knot® allows for quick line tying and hides the knot at the base of the spool for smooth line delivery

BUILT FOR FINESSE APPLICATIONS: The Custom Lite Shallow Spool is specifically crafted to effortlessly place small crankbaits, finesse swimbaits and light soft plastics with ease. official_feature_text: Okuma’s new Halogen reels take on the same great platform as last year's Serrano. These edgy new reels feature a dark black design with hints of purple to really make them stand out. The Halogen is a carbon fiber reel that comes in at only 7.0 ounces. It is lightweight, durable, and corrosion-resistant. The Halogen features a 5BB + 1RB precision stainless steel bearing drive for smooth, long casts as well as a consistent retrieve. The quick-set anti-reverse bearing is perfect for solid hooksets. The precision-cut, high-strength brass main, and pinion gears keep the reel running smooth and silent. The Halogen reels feature an externally adjustable magnetic cast control for easy, on-the-fly adjustments. This compact bodied reel has a 33.5mm machined aluminum spool that you can pack on your braid or monofilament line. And the multi-disc drag washers give out consistent performance. Available in two gear ratios, 6.5:1 and 7.2:1, it is available in both left (101) and right-hand (100) retrieves.

official_feature_text: Okuma’s new Halogen reels take on the same great platform as last year's Serrano. These edgy new reels feature a dark black design with hints of purple to really make them stand out. The Halogen is a carbon fiber reel that comes in at only 7.0 ounces. It is lightweight, durable, and corrosion-resistant. The Halogen features a 5BB + 1RB precision stainless steel bearing drive for smooth, long casts as well as a consistent retrieve. The quick-set anti-reverse bearing is perfect for solid hooksets. The precision-cut, high-strength brass main, and pinion gears keep the reel running smooth and silent. The Halogen reels feature an externally adjustable magnetic cast control for easy, on-the-fly adjustments. This compact bodied reel has a 33.5mm machined aluminum spool that you can pack on your braid or monofilament line. And the multi-disc drag washers give out consistent performance. Available in two gear ratios, 6.5:1 and 7.2:1, it is available in both left (101) and right-hand (100) retrieves.

official_feature_text: The Lew’s® HyperMag® ITB 150 baitcast reel delivers a new level of high-performance engineering. The ultra-lightweight magnesium frame and C45 carbon side plates provide a rigid, no-flex foundation that enhances durability while minimizing weight for all-day comfort. At its core, the reel features the innovative Paramag® ITB magnetic braking system, a highly responsive magnetic system that seamlessly adjusts, providing precisely the right amount of force in proportion to your casting speed. The hard anodized aluminum Speed Gears®, machined on Hamai CNC machines, ensures unmatched durability and solid stability, while the P2 Super Pinion® bearing-supported pinion gear ensures precise alignment and smooth, consistent performance. The patented Speed Keeper® hook keeper offers secure, convenient storage for any size hook, while the Speed Dial® line indicator simplifies line type and pound test identification. The Speed Knot® quick line attachment spool makes rigging up faster and easier than ever, requiring less effort of regular spools and hiding the knot securely at the base. For long days on the water, the carbon handle with custom EVA knobs provides a lightweight yet secure grip, reducing fatigue without sacrificing control. Built for ultimate control and packed with advanced features, this reel offers an exceptional balance of strength, smoothness, and convenience.

Built to pay homage to the American Warrior. Forged from the finest raw materials and tested relentlessly in the harshest elements – to deliver nothing short of the best. The Tier 1® LFS is built for all-day comfort and control on the water and answers the call of competitive anglers who demand the toughest, longest-lasting, top-level performance reels. The MultiCam Dip Process gives every single Tier 1 reel a unique military camo design.
Make no mistake, the team behind Lew’s American Hero series is absolutely committed to offering top-level performance gear that excels on the water and puts more fish in the boat. However, the heart of the series is much more than the product. Zirconia line guide

SUPERIOR DESIGN for high-level performance, all-day comfort and years of fishing
RELIABILITY with a rock-solid warranty for peace of mind on the water

There is simply no gear system that operates with the smoothness of the P2 Super Pinion. This translates to effortless operation on the water. Take your mind off the reel and put it back on the fishing with the Tier 1’s P2 Super Pinion

REMARKABLE CASTING with the easy-to-adjust MCS braking system. Lew’s dependable Magnetic Control System puts the angler back in control of long, consistent, and effortless casts. The MCS is a full-release magnetic braking system that is adjusted on an external palming plate, for quick and simple modifications. A critical feature for competitive angling as lure weights, wind, and casting conditions change. Keep your line in the water and out of the bird nest with the Tier 1’s MCS

SUPERIOR DESIGN for high-level performance, all-day comfort and years of fishing. The superior machining of the Tier 1 means a dependable and reliable reel that has been expertly built and relentlessly tested. The 15 pound drag system and 95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle are prepared for the fight. Featuring no-slip Combat Grip® paddle knobs and thumb bar. official_feature_text: Okuma’s new Serrano reels feature a lightweight, corrosion resistant graphite body and side plates and are designed with a new, more compact body, all fitting nicely in the palm of your hand. Within this new design you will find the Serrano feature packed, sharp to look at, and priced right. The Serrano features a 6BB + 1RB precision stainless steel bearing drive system for long, smooth casting and the Quick-Set anti-reverse bearing bodes well for solid hook sets. The precision cut, high strength brass main and pinion gears are smooth running and very durable. The Serrano has plenty of stopping power with multi-disc drag washers for consistent performance. And gone are the days of the professional overrun with the externally adjustable magnetic cast control system that helps to slow the spool in conditions that call for extra control and finesse. Speaking of spool, the Serrano is built around a 33.5mm machined aluminum, black anodized spool bringing the overall size of the reel down to a compact platform. Another great feature of the Serrano is the double paddle 95mm aluminum swept handle arm with comfortable handle knobs developed from golf grip material for all day cast and retrieve comfort. With a 6.5:1 and 7.2:1 gear ratio, you have a couple of options to choose from. This reel also matches up nicely with the Okuma Serrano series of rods that are currently in the Okuma lineup.

official_feature_text:
Take your casting control to the next level with Lew's® Custom TLX 150 baitcast reel. It features an aluminum frame that provides a rigid, no-flex foundation when fighting big fish, paired with C45 carbon side plates to keep weight to an absolute minimum. Its compact size ensures it palms comfortably for all-day fishing without fatigue.

At the heart of the reel is the ParaMag® RX magnetic cast control system, delivering perfect spool balance, extreme braking power, and micro-precise adjustments for exceptionally smooth casts and significantly reduced backlash. Powering your retrieve are Machined Aluminum Speed Gears® with a P2 Super Pinion®, precision-cut on Hamai CNC machines for exceptional durability and long-term performance. This system is supported by a bearing-supported pinion gear, ensuring precise alignment and solid stability for a consistently smooth retrieve.

The 5-bearing system features anti-rust, double-shielded ball bearings that maintain fluid operation while the Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing provides instant, solid hook-setting power with no backplay. The reel features a titanium-coated two-stage line guide for maximum casting distance and long-lasting durability with braided lines. A braid-ready knurled aluminum spool prevents line slippage when tying directly to the spool, while the aluminum handle with hybrid EVA/cork knobs offers a comfortable, secure grip for all-day fishing. Finished with a retractable Speed Keeper® for quick bait storage, the Custom TLX 150 baitcast reel is designed to deliver exceptional performance, strength, and control every time you hit the water.
Speed Knot™ quick line attachment spool
External lube port
Flush and drain port that allows you to flush out your reel with a water dispersing spray if accidentally submerged
Patented retractable Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows you to secure lures and Texas rigged baits without scratching your reel
Compact aluminum frame
Paramag® RX magnetic cast control system
Aluminum handle with hybrid EVA/cork knobs
Non-ported aluminum spool holds 125yds of 30lb braid
5 bearing system with stainless steel double shielded ball bearings
Carbon fiber drag system
Aircraft grade hard anodized Duralumin Speed Gears with P2 Super Pinion
95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle
2-stage titanium-coated zirconia line guide
C45 Carbon sideplates
Braid-ready knurled aluminum spool
COMPACT ALUMINUM FRAME WITH C45 CARBON SIDE PLATES provides a rigid, high-strength foundation without flex, while carbon side plates minimize overall weight for exceptional comfort and handling.
PARAMAG® RX MAGNETIC CAST CONTROL SYSTEM offers perfect spool balance, extreme braking force, and precise adjustments for smoother casting and reduced backlash.
5 ANTI-RUST BEARING SYSTEM features high corrosion resistance to ensure excellent bearing performance even in harsh, corrosive environments.

MACHINED ALUMINUM SPEED GEARS® WITH P2 SUPER PINION® are precision-cut on Hamai CNC machines for exceptional durability and long-term performance, supported by a bearing-supported pinion gear for precise alignment and solid stability.
BRAID-READY KNURLED ALUMINUM SPOOL reduces line slippage when braided line is tied directly to the spool, eliminating the need for backing.
ALUMINUM HANDLE WITH HYBRID EVA/CORK KNOBS provides a comfortable and secure grip for all-day fishing.
TITANIUM COATED TWO-STAGE LINE GUIDE is designed to maximize casting distance and is coated in titanium to withstand the abuse of braided lines.
SPEED KEEPER® offers a retractable bait keeper for quick, convenient, and secure lure storage right on the reel.
ZERO REVERSE® ONE-WAY CLUTCH BEARING delivers instant hook-setting power without any backplay.

official_feature_text: Experience unparalleled dominance on the water with Lew's® Speed Spool® RX 200 HyperSpeed® Baitcast Reel. The reel has a 9.5:1 gear ratio with a screaming fast 40" per turn retrieve speed to offer high-velocity performance. Crafted with a one-piece aluminum frame and lightweight graphite side plates, the Speed Spool RX 200 HyperSpeed delivers durability you can rely on. The ParaMag® RX magnetic braking system ensures smoother casts and reduced backlash with perfect spool balance, extreme braking power and precise braking adjustments. Designed for smooth and reliable performance, the 8-bearing system features double-shielded stainless steel ball bearings, maintaining peak efficiency throughout the life of the reel. The reel features hard-anodized aluminum Speed Gears®, delivering long-lasting strength for consistent, high-performance fishing while the carbon fiber drag system offers the control and power you need to tackle hard-fighting fish. When it comes to convenience, the reel delivers innovative features like the patented Speed Keeper® hook keeper, offering secure storage for hooks of all sizes, while the Knot Slot spool feature provides seamless and smooth attachment from line to spool. The P2 Super Pinion® ensures precise gear alignment and steady operation, and the Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing gives you instant hook-setting power with no backplay. Plus, the Speed Lube® treatment ensures exceptional performance in all weather conditions. Finished with a 95mm bowed aluminum handle, it offers comfortable, confident cranking all day long. Experience the ultimate combination of extreme speed, strength, and control with the Speed Spool RX 200 HyperSpeed.

The externally adjustable Multi-Setting Brake (MSB) dual cast control gives anglers ultimate control, allowing easy handling of light line and lures with precision. The reel also features a 95mm bowed, anodized aluminum handle with Lew’s Combat Grips® providing a comfortable and secure grip. Plus, the anodized aluminum spool tension cap comes with an audible click for added convenience.

official_feature_text: Okuma Helios XT Low Profile Baitcast Reel Lightweight Precision Meets Proven Strength The Okuma Helios XT Low Profile Baitcast Reel is built for anglers who demand high-performance casting, refined control, and dependable strength in a lightweight package. Designed with a rigid ALC aluminum frame , the Helios XT delivers exceptional durability and stability under load, while the C-40X carbon gear sideplate and palm sideplate reduce weight without sacrificing strength. At the heart of the reel is a precision drivetrain featuring a CNC-cut aluminum drive gear with anodizing paired with a machine-cut brass pinion gear . This combination ensures smooth, efficient power transfer and long-lasting performance. The 10BB + 1RB bearing system provides ultra-smooth operation, making every cast and retrieve effortless. For casting control, the Helios XT is equipped with an internal adjustable centrifugal braking system , allowing anglers to fine-tune performance for a wide range of baits and conditions. Whether you’re skipping docks, bombing casts, or working finesse presentations, this reel gives you the confidence to stay in control. When it’s time to put the pressure on, the multi-disc Stainless Steel and Carbonite drag system delivers smooth, consistent stopping power—perfect for battling hard-fighting fish. The 90mm swept aluminum handle offers a comfortable grip and increased leverage, giving you better control throughout the fight. Finished with a JDM-style audible drag click , the Helios XT provides added feedback and connection during drag engagement—an appreciated feature for anglers who want to stay dialed in. Backed by a 3-year limited warranty , the Helios XT is built to perform season after season.

official_feature_text: Okuma Safyre Low Profile Baitcast Reel Versatile Performance. Built to Fish Anywhere. The Okuma Safyre Low Profile Baitcast Reel is designed for anglers looking for dependable performance, smooth operation, and all-around versatility. Built with a lightweight, corrosion-resistant frame and sideplates , the Safyre is ready to handle both freshwater and light inshore applications with confidence. At the core of the Safyre is a durable drivetrain featuring a CNC-cut aluminum drive gear with anodizing and a machine-cut brass pinion gear , delivering efficient power transfer and long-lasting reliability. The 7BB + 1RB bearing system ensures smooth casting and retrieving, while the Quick-Set anti-reverse bearing provides solid, instant hooksets when it matters most. Designed for control and ease of use, the Safyre features an externally adjustable magnetic cast control system , allowing anglers to quickly dial in their casting performance for different lures and conditions. When it’s time to fight fish, the multi-disc composite drag system delivers consistent pressure and smooth performance, giving you the confidence to handle a wide range of species and situations. Backed by a 1-year limited warranty , the Okuma Safyre Low Profile Baitcast Reel is a reliable, versatile option for anglers looking to get the most out of every cast.

official_feature_text: Fastest in the Team Lew’s® line up, the HyperSpeed baitcast reel has a 9.5:1 gear ratio with a screaming 40” RPT retrieve speed to offer high-velocity performance. Ideal for speed cranking big baits and muscling fish out of heavy cover with a lightning-fast retrieve.  Housed inside a lightweight, one-piece aluminum frame and side plate is a 10-bearing system with stainless steel double-shielded ball bearings greased with Speed Lube® for exceptional smoothness. Lew’s HyperSpeed is engineered with Hamai-cut alloy Speed Gears® for smooth, effortless cranking power with less wear and longer reel life
Patented retractable Speed Keeper® hook keeper allows you to secure lures and Texas rigged baits without scratching your reel
Combat Grip® thumb Bar
Speed Lube® for exceptional smoothness and performance in all weather conditions
Carbon fiber drag system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion™ bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed carbon fiber handle
Zirconia line guide
Aluminum handle sideplate and graphite palm sideplate
Machine forged anodized aluminum U-shape 34mm spool
SCREAMING FAST with premium 9.5:1 gear ratio, delivering 40-inch RPT (recovery per turn)
EXCEPTIONAL CONTROL: Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing for supreme control of the retrieve. 6-pin QuietCast® externally Adjustable Centrifugal Brake (ACB) for unbeatable castability
LIGHTWEIGHT DURABILITY: Lew’s® HyperSpeed LFS Series baitcast reel provides lightweight performance with a one-piece aluminum frame
SUPERIOR DESIGN: 120/12 mono capacity, and 120-yards of 50-pound braided line so you’re ready to fish under any conditions
ROCK SOLID RELIABILITY with the finest materials, industry-leading craftsmanship and a one-year warranty backed by the Customer Support Team at Lew’s
QuietCast externally Adjustable Centrifugal Brake system
Hard anodized aluminum alloy Speed Gears®, precision cut on Hamai CNC machines with P2 SuperPinion® bearing supported pinion gear
95mm bowed anodized aluminum handle with EVA knobs
Combat Grip® thumb bar
External lube port

SCREAMING FAST: This baitcast reel features a screaming fast 9.5:1 gear ratio with a 40-inch RPT (recovery per turn). The premium 10-bearing system has stainless steel double-shielded ball bearings providing cranking smoothness. The 20-pound carbon fiber drag system provides fish-fighting strength that matches the hyper fast retrieve

LFS Series features a Zero Reverse one-way clutch bearing for supreme control of the retrieve, powerful hook sets and ideal cranking. The 6-pin QuietCast® externally Adjustable Centrifugal Brake (ACB) offers unbeatable casting and quick on-the-water adjustments to respond to changing wind conditions and lure weight. Featuring alloy Speed Gears® and Lew’s® Speed Lube® for exceptionally quiet and smooth casting

LIGHTWEIGHT DURABILITY: Lew’s HyperSpeed LFS Series baitcast reel provides lightweight performance with a one-piece aluminum frame and a drilled and forged anodized aluminum U-style 34mm spool. The 95mm bowed aluminum handle with EVA pro knobs supplies all-day comfort
SUPERIOR DESIGN: This reel has a mono capacity of 120/12 and can hold up to 120-yards of 50-pound braided line so you’re ready to fish under any conditions
